capabilities.title: Multi-agent framework: separate analyst, risk, and execution agents with defined handoff contracts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents: specialized agents for technical analysis, fundamentals, sentiment, and risk management
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Nexus adapts the role-separation pattern as typed fundamentals, technical, sentiment, and risk research handoffs followed by one balanced synthesis. It deliberately omits a trader/execution agent and does not claim a standalone LangGraph topology.

capabilities.title: Fundamental analysis agent: earnings, revenue growth, P/E, sector context
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents fundamentals agent persona and tool set
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The protected SEC route resolves a ticker to SEC Companyfacts, extracts recent XBRL revenue, income, asset, liability, and diluted-EPS facts with period-over-period context, and hands them to the fundamentals lens. Unsupported valuation or sector conclusions stay unavailable.

capabilities.title: Technical analysis agent: trend detection, support/resistance, indicator synthesis
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The technical lens receives verified price, 24-hour change, seven-day trend, and momentum score inputs. It must identify its limited evidence and cannot invent support, resistance, or indicators.

capabilities.title: Sentiment analysis agent: news, social media, and options flow sentiment scoring
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The sentiment lens combines the verified Fear & Greed value with bounded symbol-matched public market or crypto headlines. Social and options-flow sentiment remain explicitly unavailable rather than fabricated.

capabilities.title: Risk management agent: position sizing, drawdown limits, stop-loss recommendations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents risk agent with portfolio-level checks
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The research handoff names invalidation and missing account constraints while the deterministic manual Position Sizer calculates fixed-risk exposure, stop distance, risk/reward, loss at stop, and Kelly reference without placing orders.

capabilities.title: Agent debate: bullish and bearish agents argue thesis before final recommendation
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents debate mode: agents challenge each other's reasoning
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Every structured result contains separate evidence-bounded bull and bear cases before the synthesis. Nexus uses one reviewable council response instead of multiplying provider calls or simulating hidden autonomous personas.

capabilities.title: Backtesting loop: evaluate agent recommendations against historical price data
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not generate or execute a historical trading strategy, so a recommendation backtest would manufacture performance confidence from non-stationary model prose. Market Review preserves human-authored outcome continuity without claiming predictive validity.

capabilities.title: Live order execution via broker API
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not a trading execution system. Live order routing is out of scope.
